speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice of the Newborn. The history of full-term birth, exclusive breastfeeding, lack of family history, and the pending labs showing predominantly unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia are classic for this common, benign condition. I recommend frequent feeding to promote stooling and hydration; if the bilirubin levels exceed safe thresholds, phototherapy may be required.
